entities.summary: Mark Gregor Strang Donaldson, is an Australian soldier and a recipient of the Victoria Cross for Australia, the highest award in the Australian honours system. Then Trooper Donaldson was a member of the Special Air Service Regiment (SASR) when he exposed himself to enemy fire to protect injured troops and then rescued an interpreter under heavy enemy fire in the Battle of Khaz Oruzgan during Operation Slipper, the Australian contribution to the War in Afghanistan. He was presented with the decoration by the Governor-General of Australia, Quentin Bryce, in a ceremony in Canberra on 16 January 2009.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Mark Donaldson's actions during Operation Slipper in Afghanistan led to the rescue of an interpreter under heavy enemy fire, saving lives and demonstrating exceptional bravery. His Victoria Cross for Australia award highlights his significant regional impact.
